# Istikhara — استخارہ

> Receive divine guidance through Quranic verse (قرآنی آیات کے ذریعے الہٰی رہنمائی).

Istikhara is a calm, ad-free, privacy-first web app for Muslims in Pakistan, India, and the diaspora. It teaches the Sunnah Istikhara (two rak'ahs and the dua from Sahih al-Bukhari 1162) and offers quiet Quranic reflection in Urdu and English using verified Al-Quran Cloud editions.

## Key Pages (Urdu & English)
- Home: https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/ur/ | https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/en/
- Sunnah Method: https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/ur/guide | https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/en/guide
- Istikhara Dua: https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/ur/dua | https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/en/dua
- Reflection Set (40 Verses): https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/ur/verses | https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/en/verses
- Verse of the Day: https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/ur/daily | https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/en/daily
- Quran Verse Video Studio: https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/ur/studio | https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/en/studio
- FAQ: https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/ur/faq | https://istikhara-quran-app.netlify.app/en/faq
